title: Apple Notes
whyItMatters: NoteStore.sqlite holds every note, folder and attachment.

cleanup.exportFirst: In Notes select the notes you keep and use File > Export as PDF to save each one to a folder outside the app.
cleanup.signOut: Turn Notes off under iCloud in your Apple Account settings, so the notes stop syncing to this Mac.
steps: Quit Notes so the note database is not in use.
Delete the group.com.apple.notes folder named in the plan, then empty the Trash.
cleanup.risk: Local notes and attachments are removed from this Mac. Notes stored in iCloud remain in the Apple Account.
